create_VisualVoiceUNet: create a VisualVoiceUNet model for audio-visual speech separation with custom feature dimensions
build_Resnet18_extractor: build a Resnet18 feature extractor with configurable input channels and pooling type
initialize_weights: initialize model weights using weights_init for Conv, BatchNorm, and Linear layers
construct_unet_conv_block: construct a UNet downsampling convolution block with batch normalization and LeakyReLU
run_visualvoice_forward: run the VisualVoiceUNet forward pass with audio mix spectrogram and visual features to produce separation mask
